propositions: The code-review Pass-1 finder batch runner does not emit token usage on its batch step output, causing CloudWatch totals to underreport every code review by the entire Pass-1 finder leg.
The finalize step already consumes _usage from batch step outputs and folds it into totals (finalize.py:169-172), but receives nothing from the code-review finder batch.
Pass-1 finder token usage must be aggregated in batch_runner.py and emitted under the _usage key, mirroring the established pattern from the plan-review side (d52a).
The stale follow-up comment at finalize.py:139-141 describing the missing _usage surface must be removed once the emit-side fix is complete.
Unit tests must verify that finder-batch token usage is included in finalized code-review totals, failing before the fix and passing after.
